script:
Chu Chuan (Rich Young Master)
Chu Chuan is the son of a wealthy merchant named Chu Wanhu. Chu Chuan's home is on an island with his father's power base, Longevity Gate. On the island, there's also the doctor Su Shengce, who is not only highly skilled in medicine but also particularly caring toward him, the highly skilled bodyguard Li Hao, and the steward Ma San who manages big and small affairs on the island.
Chu Chuan has been pampered since childhood, and all the servants of Longevity Gate respect him greatly. Chu Chuan has been on this island since childhood and is familiar with every place on the island, except for one place. He can vaguely see the sign for that place: "Forbidden Area - Bottomless Pit." He asked Chu Wanhu about it many times, but Chu Wanhu would always panic and tell him not to ask too many questions before leaving. Sometimes when Chu Chuan pressed further, he would even beat him. When Chu Chuan asked about his mother, Chu Wanhu only said she died in childbirth and wouldn't say anything else.
In the 45th year of the Sea Calendar, Chu Chuan met his stepmother (Wang Tingting). Chu Chuan was only about 10 years old at the time, while his stepmother was only about 17-18 years old. In Chu Chuan's impression, Wang Tingting treated him well and often played with him. The first time Chu Chuan brought Wang Tingting to the forbidden area, Wang Tingting seemed particularly excited. The forbidden area was a cave with the entrance blocked by very large stones - probably only mountain-breaking tools could open it. As Chu Chuan gradually grew up, he began to understand why a woman like Wang Tingting would approach someone 20 years older than herself. But he had to admit, his father had good taste. When Chu Chuan had nothing to do, he would think of Wang Tingting, thinking of his stepmother's figure, secretly thinking that Chu Wanhu's family fortune and the woman Wang Tingting would both be his.
In the 52nd year of the Sea Calendar, Chu Chuan had reached puberty. He had never left the island and remained the young master of Longevity Gate. He had a beautiful maid named Tang Yaoyao who was with him day and night. Chu Chuan developed feelings for her - this was his first contact with the opposite sex.
One day, Chu Chuan wanted to take Tang Yaoyao to a deserted place. In a daze, they came to the forbidden area - the Bottomless Pit. But he saw Wang Tingting sneaking out of the forbidden area alone. Afraid that Wang Tingting would see him with Tang Yaoyao, Chu Chuan hid.
But his affair with Tang Yaoyao was still discovered by his father and Wang Tingting. One day, the family held a criticism meeting. His father didn't beat him as before but just sat there quietly watching, as if he wasn't his son and it had nothing to do with him. But Wang Tingting was different - she strongly opposed Chu Chuan being with Tang Yaoyao. Then Tang Yaoyao shouted loudly, "Master, save me! I know Madam's secret!" Wang Tingting panicked and immediately had the steward take Tang Yaoyao away to "handle it cleanly." Chu Chuan never saw Tang Yaoyao again. Chu Chuan was sad for a long time. Although he continued to wander among flowers and frequently had relations, his heart was like dead ashes and he never fell in love again. From then on, his father's health deteriorated day by day, and his mind became unclear.
[55th Year of Sea Calendar, September 27th]
Chu Chuan had lost interest in all the maids on the island. Only one person could excite him now - his stepmother Wang Tingting. Taking out the aphrodisiac he had someone buy from outside, Chu Chuan chuckled wickedly...
8 PM: Unable to bear the loneliness, Chu Chuan came to Chu Wanhu and Wang Tingting's residence. He saw the mentally confused Chu Wanhu sleeping while Wang Tingting was handling affairs nearby. Chu Chuan approached to flirt with Wang Tingting and took the opportunity to put the aphrodisiac in a cup. Chu Chuan told Wang Tingting that Chu Wanhu was old and frail, no longer capable, while he was young and vigorous, more suitable in age. The family business would all be his in the future - she might as well follow him and enjoy life later. While talking, Chu Chuan inadvertently saw a letter on the table. Wang Tingting immediately stood up and hid the letter behind her.
Chu Chuan knew this letter must be important and struggled with Wang Tingting. Finally, the letter was torn, and each held half in their hands. Burning with desire, Chu Chuan had no time to examine the letter carefully. He roughly pushed the still-lying Chu Wanhu to the ground, then violently pushed Wang Tingting onto the bed. Unfortunately, Wang Tingting's head hit the bed frame and she immediately stopped struggling. Chu Chuan tried to listen to her heartbeat and found it had stopped.
Chu Chuan panicked. He covered the wide-eyed Wang Tingting with a blanket, but when he turned around, he saw Chu Wanhu staring at him with wide eyes. Terrified, he fled.
Only Clue: None.
acts_goal: Lead everyone to point the killer's identity toward Chu Wanhu.
